svg.aria-label: The full mode of academic-paper against the full mode of paper: nine agents against five roles, with the citation scripts as a session step. Left, academic-paper 3.2.0 as boxes in order: 1 intake_agent; 2 literature_strategist_agent; 3 structure_architect_agent; 4 argument_builder_agent; 5 draft_writer_agent; 11 visualization_agent, if quantitative; 6 and 7, in parallel; 8 peer_reviewer_agent; 9 formatter_agent. Right, paper 2.0.0 as boxes in order: session: intake; role: literature strategist; role: planner; role: draft writer; role: visualization; session: lookup.py cite-keys and check-urls; role: peer reviewer; session: references, compile, /writing.
